figures.finding: The Tanzania Film Board lists script writers (Waandishi wa Miswada) among the film practitioners it registers, and every film practitioner must be registered and licensed by it; the practitioner's accreditation and ID cost TZS 30,000 for three years. No writers' agreement or minimum fee was found.

tried.web-search: 2026-11-04: WebSearch (9 of 10, standard): 'Tanzania wasanii wa maigizo jukwaani malipo kima cha chini BASATA mwongozo ada msanii mwigizaji mwandishi wa michezo ya kuigiza' (items 7, 8, 9) (No pay rule, minimum or tariff for stage actors, directors or playwrights; leads: IFACCA's note of The Citizen (23 Nov 2024) on BASATA's amended regulations, The Chanzo (2021, opinion on BASATA's bureaucracy), Daily News on BASATA revenue, Music In Africa items.)
tried.institution: 2026-11-04: BASATA (Baraza la Sanaa la Taifa): Machapisho → Kanuni https://www.basata.go.tz/publications/regulation (three texts listed: Kanuni za BASATA 2018, the 2025 amendments, and 'KANUNI ZA BARAZA LA SANAA LA TAIFA, G.N 137 TAREHE 22 MEI, 2026'); the 2026 Regulations, Tangazo la Serikali Na. 137 la tarehe 22/5/2026 under Sheria ya Baraza la Sanaa la Taifa (Sura ya 204) https://www.basata.go.tz/uploads/documents/sw-1780562264-KANUNI%20ZA%20BARAZA%20LA%20SANAA%20LA%20TAIFA,%20G.N%20137%20TAREHE%2022%20MEI,%202026.pdf (files/m10/tz-basata-gn137-2026.pdf, sha256 5600d0fc29d3805aabf250dc139d5fdd0c50ee66bf4e8c4e8c2be761f4bdc5d0, 44 pages) read by text extraction; Miongozo (guidelines: ethics, a 2025 drawing contest) and Usajili na Ada pages (items 7, 8, 9) (The 2026 Regulations register, permit and license artists, promoters, groups and venues and charge fees (Jedwali la Pili 'ADA ZA USAJILI NA VIBALI': e.g. '(d) Msanii binafsi au aliye kwenye kikundi 10,000' registration, '(g) Wasanii binafsi 10,000' permit, '(c) Promota wa kazi za sanaa 50,000'); a contract is asked for only to perform abroad ('nakala ya mkataba wa kazi') or for a child artist. No pay, fee floor or royalty for a stage actor, director or playwright anywhere in the text.)
tried.official-register: 2026-11-04: GN No. 488 of 2020, Kanuni za Filamu na Michezo ya Kuigiza (the Board's gazette copy, https://www.filmboard.go.tz/uploads/publications/sw-1595400697-GN-%20NO%20488%20KANUNI%20ZA%20FILAMU%20NA%20MICHEZO%20YA%20KUIGIZA,%202020.pdf), fetched again (first try reset, second 200) and read whole for series (tamthiliya, episode), stage plays (mchezo wa kuigiza) and pay (Found the per-episode series permit, the series and play classification fees and the registration fees for stage acting, directing and writing; no incentive and no pay)
tried.trade-press: 2026-11-04: IFACCA news, 'Basata's new regulations to revitalise Tanzania's arts scene', quoting The Citizen of 23 November 2024 (https://www.thecitizen.co.tz/tanzania/news/entertainment/basata-s-new-regulations-to-revitalise-tanzania-s-arts-scene-4833694) https://ifacca.org/news/2024/11/23/basatas-new-regulations-revitalise-tanzanias-arts/ (files/m10/tz-ifacca-2024.html, sha256 87bb04d554b14c5acdc76ed93ddb40a22fa6fee50ef8c13ba69b37fa528e3794) read (items 7, 8, 9) ('Basata introducing new amendments to its 2018 regulations. The changes are expected to ease the burden on the organizers of events, particularly those hosting festivals or inviting foreign artistes': fees and permits, not performers' pay.)
tried.archive: 2026-11-04: Common Crawl 'tz,go,basata)/' (CC-MAIN-2026-43: 25 captures; -39: 46; -30: 99; -21: 15; 2025-51: 40), lists read for regulations, guidelines and fee pages; the CC-MAIN-2026-39 capture (2026-09-10) of the G.N. 137 of 2026 PDF fetched (files/m10/tz-cc-gn137-2026.pdf, sha256 793df49fb8026a6f65a325ecfabe21a229320249b91c76968104c6a043f0ca01) and its text compared with the live copy (identical text); 2025-51 holds the 2025 amending regulations' PDF (items 7, 8, 9) (The archived Regulations match the live ones: no pay terms for stage work in force since 22 May 2026.
